output.audience_insight: Hypothesis: independent shop owners may need to pause what they are doing to attend to the shop, so a wellness offer that allows them to save a draft and return later could feel relevant to their routines.
output.campaign_description: “Pause, Pick Up” dramatizes a shop owner pausing to handle the demands of the shop, saving a draft in the Wellness offer 119 app, and returning to it later. TikTok introduces the scenario through short videos, while Instagram Reels reinforce the idea with concise demonstrations of the save-and-return feature.

channel_plan.format_note: Short vertical videos show someone pausing to handle a shop task, saving a draft in the app, then returning to it.
channel_plan.role: Introduce the offer through relatable, interruption-led moments featuring independent shop owners.

channel_plan.format_note: Vertical Reels pair a simple app demonstration with a shop-owner scenario; keep the save-draft action legible on screen.
channel_plan.role: Reinforce the save-and-return message with concise, visually clear demonstrations.
